notes:
Saving a full-length video at its original size and speed now preserves compatible H.264 picture packets and AAC audio. Crops in time, speed changes, and resized edits use a higher-quality encoder setting. Video enlargements use Lanczos scaling and a mild contrast-adaptive pass on brightness detail. These choices are automatic.

Verified with 13 media checks and a 1,675-frame desktop gallery import. The saved video and audio packets matched the master.
